Game Overview

In Rooftop Pursuit The Great Penitentiary Escape, the core idea is straightforward: chase escaped prisoners across treacherous rooftops in Rooftop Pursuit: The Great Penitentiary Escape. Navigate obstacles, time your jumps, and use elevators to stay ahead in this thrilling, fast-paced side-scroller. Upgrade your skills, rely on quick reflexes, and experience the vibrant chaos of a prison riot from above.
